build_gpt2_dictionary_agent: build a Gpt2DictionaryAgent to tokenize text using a HuggingFace GPT-2 tokenizer with special tokens
build_t5_dictionary_agent: build a T5DictionaryAgent to tokenize and detokenize text using a HuggingFace T5 tokenizer
build_llama_dictionary_agent: build a LlamaDictionaryAgent to tokenize text using a HuggingFace Llama tokenizer with fast or slow mode
build_dialoGPT_dictionary_agent: build a DialoGPTDictionaryAgent to tokenize text using a Microsoft DialoGPT tokenizer for dialogue tasks
review_huggingface_dictionary_agent: review the HuggingFaceDictionaryAgent abstract base class and its txt2vec and vec2txt tokenization methods
